title: T10 sequential Sutherland-Hodgman polygon clipping contract

modules.name: polygon_clip_engine

ports.name: constant_c_i
ports.description: Signed half-plane constant with 46 fractional bits

ports.name: result_trusted_o
ports.description: No numerical, capacity, parallel, or residual error occurred

ports.name: parallel_edge_o
ports.description: At least one crossing used the conservative near-parallel rule

ports.name: capacity_overflow_o
ports.description: An output candidate exceeded the 1024-vertex capacity

ports.name: quantization_margin_used_o
ports.description: A classification or generated intersection used negative tolerance

ports.name: residual_violation_o
ports.description: A generated intersection failed residual reclassification

ports.name: ram_read_data_i
ports.description: Packed signed Q16.16 X and Y read response

ports.name: ram_write_buffer_o
ports.description: Complement of the captured input buffer

behavior: Read the last input vertex first and then addresses zero through count minus one to close the polygon.
Reuse one half-plane classifier for endpoint and generated-intersection residual checks.
Emit B for inside-inside, intersection for inside-outside, intersection then B for outside-inside, and nothing for outside-outside.
Use the inner endpoint as a conservative output when a crossing is classified near-parallel.
Filter adjacent repeated vertices and remove a repeated closing vertex from the returned count.
Write accepted vertices sequentially into the opposite RAM buffer.
constraints: The RAM read interface returns a one-cycle valid response for each request.
The maximum stored output count is 1024 vertices.
The upstream controller must wait while busy is asserted.
Any parallel, saturation, capacity, or residual flag makes result_trusted low.
corner_cases: Zero input vertices complete without a RAM transaction and return empty.
A full-capacity input can generate an overflow candidate; the engine stops before an out-of-range write.
A boundary endpoint can be produced by adjacent edges and is written only once.
A denominator at the near-parallel threshold retains the inner endpoint and marks the result untrusted.
verification_cases: Clip a square through all four edge transition cases and compare every output vertex.
Check all-inside, all-outside, empty-input, duplicate-endpoint, and near-parallel cases.
Use 1024 alternating inside and outside vertices to force capacity overflow without an out-of-range write.
Reject one busy-time start and check completion pulse width.
